series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_qc_note: All ten frames passed visual review, are 1376x768 sRGB PNGs, are uploaded to Drive folder 13OX8F00yUGUB4cXK7WndAHVN4gcBy0Tv, and each Drive MD5 matches its local file; Drive lists exactly ten images. Eight passed first time. IMG0291 needed one rerender to restore the cool silver-white hair and a hard male jaw after coming back brown-haired and soft-faced. IMG0300 arrived letterboxed, was reframed to full-bleed, and needed two rerenders: an ankle-length flared coat with the hood up (the Batch 029 failure recurring), then a bald crown. Director's boundaries held across all ten: no cave interior, cavern mouth, tunnel or vent interior is shown; no sheep is taken on camera; no blood or struggle appears before IMG0299's deliberately ambiguous skull; and no dragon or dragon-sign appears anywhere, since DRG-VAL-001 is not revealed until Batch 032. Standing flags: the elder's ankle-length-coat-and-hood drift has now occurred twice (029, 030) and needs hood, cowl and full-length-coat negations plus the positive knee-length description every time; hair tone is drifting frame to frame across Batches 028-030, so Batch 031 must carry one explicit hair value.

scenes.visual_beat: Dynamic medium lateral tracking angle — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved on the rerender. Pass 1 gave him warm light-brown hair and a soft, near-feminine face; the approved frame is cool platinum silver-white, hard angular jaw with stubble shadow, mouth open mid-shout, head turned three-quarters away — no braiding, no likeness.

scenes.visual_beat: Compressed telephoto dramatic subject framing — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Telephoto at 65mm, head fully away with only jaw and ear showing; hair loose and unplaited — no scalp braid. Faint coloured blobs in the far background are out-of-focus pasture flowers, acceptable at this blur.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium cinematic subject focus — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. The ewe at the mineral lick carries the compulsion beat entirely; lamb behind, two more sheep already climbing. No people, no props.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental storytelling tableau — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Four or five clanfolk working the flock back, no two doing the same thing and none lined up; long unplaited silver-white hair on every head, no black clothing. The child with the crook keeps the community readable as a whole people rather than a cast.

scenes.visual_beat: High-elevation geographic / scale reveal — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Scale reveal: flock as pale seeds, a dozen steaming vents, and one tiny figure alone on the black ground at the right edge.

scenes.visual_beat: Towering vertical scale composition — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Raw broken basalt and scree with sulphur above; no cut steps, no coursed blocks, no cave. Hair loose, no braid.

scenes.visual_beat: Macro environmental / material texture insert — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Sulphur crust, one recent hoofprint and two strands of wool — the evidence beat without a body. No bones here, so the skull in IMG0299 still lands as a separate revelation.

scenes.visual_beat: Intimate close-up detail / expression beat — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass with a continuity flag. The grief beat works and the eyes stay shut and shadowed, but the hair reads darker and more ash-blond here than the silver-white in IMG0296 — inside the range, but this is now the third batch in which hair tone drifts frame to frame and it needs a single explicit value in Batch 031.

scenes.visual_beat: Extreme close-up tactile / light study — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Sun-bleached horned skull on wet black basalt, no flesh, no blood, no tooth or drag marks: reads as weather, a fall, or something older. Nothing points at a dragon, which is correct — DRG-VAL-001 is not revealed until Batch 032.

scenes.visual_beat: Transitional wide horizon / bridge framing — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved on the second rerender. Pass 1 had the elder in an ankle-length flared coat with the hood up (the Batch 029 failure recurring); pass 2 fixed the coat to knee length with trousers and boots visible but left a pink bald patch on his crown; pass 3 keeps the correct knee-length silhouette and gives him a full head of hair to the nape. Reframed from a 1376x744 image area to full-bleed 1376x768 to strip 12 px letterbox bars.
